'''Spacetrooper Platoon 243-XT''' was a unit<ref name="Briefing" /> of sixty<ref name="Numbers">In ''[[The Briefing of Spacetrooper Platoon 243-XT]]'', [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Clayton Balrog]] notes that the crew of ''[[GrimDeath I]]'' numbered three hundred, and his forces were outnumber by a ratio of 5-to-1, indicating that the platoon numbered sixty members.</ref> [[Zero-G assault stormtrooper]]s commanded by [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Clayton Balrog]]. The unit was stationed aboard a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and was split into [[Strike Force One]] and [[Strike Force Two]] during missions. The unit participated in a mission capture the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[GrimDeath I]]''.<ref name="Briefing" />
